response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT p.fundflux FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry), grp AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY fundflux) SELECT fundflux, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share_of_total, cnt * 1.0 / (SUM(cnt) OVER () * 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER ()) AS ratio_to_avg_per_source FROM grp ORDER BY cnt DESC
